display_name: Report token spend per budget line
description: T1 S3 (2026-08-05, budget-line rollup) + D4 close-out (2026-08-06, exclusion-scoping). Reports token usage per budget_line, optionally filtered by lane_id and/or budget_line, joining this plugin's own managed_session/session_claude_mapping tables against session_ledger_service's session/event tables -- the first cross-plugin state read of its kind in this codebase. Returns one entry per distinct budget_line, every managed_session row landing in exactly one of five declared classes: sessions_covered (usage found and attributed, sessions_multi_row_resolved names how many required disambiguating among sibling ledger rows sharing one external_session_id), sessions_uncovered (a genuine, still-open attribution gap -- no mapping row at all, or a mapped claude_session_id that never resolved to any ledger session), sessions_no_llm_turns (a CONFIRMED true zero -- every mapped claude_session_id resolved to a real ledger session, none of them carry a single usage-bearing event), sessions_excluded_pre_landing (created before the SessionStart hook's own landing commit -- could never have been captured, regardless of host), and sessions_excluded_operator_hosted (host=operator, permanently outside the hook's contract by design). An as_of staleness timestamp (the latest usage event covered, null when nothing is covered), a usage dict of generic per-field token sums taken verbatim from the vendor's own usage payload (currently claude_code's input/output/cache-creation/cache-read counts), and a nested by_model breakdown (same five-class shape, keyed on the spawn-time model override, empty string when unset). Read-only, issues no writes. Raw token counts only -- no dollar-cost conversion.
embedding_description: Report token spend for a fleet lane or budget line -- input, output, and cache tokens used, per model, with every uncovered/excluded/zero-usage session declared by its own class, never lumped together. Distinct from list_sessions (which sessions exist) and session_status (one session's live state). Read-only, never a spawn or mutation.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: budget_lines: an array with one entry per distinct budget_line among matching managed_session rows. Each entry carries budget_line, sessions_covered, sessions_uncovered, sessions_no_llm_turns, sessions_multi_row_resolved, sessions_excluded_pre_landing, sessions_excluded_operator_hosted, as_of (ISO-8601 or null), usage (per-field token sums), and by_model (the same shape, keyed on model).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the usage totals and as_of freshness for the budget_line(s) asked about. Treat the five session-count fields as genuinely distinct, never sum sessions_uncovered with the excluded/no_llm_turns counts to get 'not covered' -- sessions_uncovered alone is the open attribution gap worth investigating; sessions_excluded_pre_landing and sessions_excluded_operator_hosted are permanently unattributable by design (nothing to fix); sessions_no_llm_turns is a confirmed zero (nothing to fix either, it just never had a turn). Only a nonzero sessions_uncovered means real spend may not be reflected in the usage totals -- never present that without saying so, and never describe an excluded or no_llm_turns count as if it were the same kind of gap.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A read-only join across this plugin's own managed_session/session_claude_mapping tables and session_ledger_service's session/event tables via StateManagementInterface; no state mutation, no host interaction.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound on this solet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: state_service_unavailable indicates a platform binding problem, not a caller error -- report it rather than retrying with different filters.
